status: Prospective adjudication; no new trial results
authorization: Parent/user selected exploratory prescription packages despite unresolved historical physical PG reliability; this does not resolve or supersede oracle reliability gates.

primary_score.metric: Sampled training episodic return averaged over trailing 200000 environment steps at common 7900000 steps
primary_score.secondary: Final100 completed training episodes, separately labeled
primary_score.incomplete: Culled/failed runs retain matched early windows; no late score extrapolation
primary_score.replication_limit: No multi-seed statistical superiority claim; same-seed reproduced controls are execution parity, not independent replicates

replay_selection: After contracts and real snapshots exist, prioritize informative winner/control or collapse/control checkpoints at matched4M/end8M. Preserve unsuccessful runs and finite update measurements where available; do not duplicate training.
required_replay_evidence: Pinned actual trainer/Args/architecture and shared sources
Compiled recorded alpha/beta/logprob/old-value agreement on identical observations
Complete update trace and exact stored final model
Independent gradient/JVP contracts before derivative claims
local_oracle_limits: Historical dense physical PG replicate agreement remains unresolved until actual measurements pass reliability gates
Shared inverse-CDF finite forks use a labeled diagnostic sampling law
Finite raw and clip-then-FP32 normalized returns are different objectives
Old fixed critic terminal tails are estimates rather than unbiased infinite-return credit
Conditional replica uncertainty omits state-population and training-seed variability
Old pre-softplus logits and independently saved first model are absent; do not invent them
iteration_rule: Compare scores and matched physical/update evidence before selecting a further new version. Compound score gains motivate targeted isolation; they do not retrospectively certify the proposed microscopic cause.
recovery_reason: Original v15 test-only missing dim; unchanged trainer algorithm/settings, failed/skipped provenance retained.
